sections.content: egyenesen ('straight') and the directional forms jobbra ('to the right') and balra ('to the left') are used for giving directions. jobbra and balra are built from jobb and bal with the suffix -ra/-re, which turns a plain location word into a direction word.

items.english: Go straight, then to the right.
The taxi is to the left.

sections.content: Compare jobb van (it is on the right, a location) with jobbra megy (goes to the right, a direction) -- the -ra ending is exactly what turns 'right' from a place into a direction, the same suffix used for hová questions.
